display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-07-D3-27 Integrated Approaches for Retrofitting Infrastructures with Innovative Energy Storage Technologies – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-07-D3-27 Integrated Approaches for Retrofitting Infrastructures with Innovative Energy Storage Technologies
executive_summary: Horizon Europe innovation action for demonstrating improved energy storage through retrofitting obsolete infrastructure. Eligible Dutch legal entities can participate in a consortium; company funding is up to 70% under the lump-sum methodology. The topic has EUR 22.5 million and expects around EUR 7.5 million per project, while allowing different requests. Planned opening: 4 August 2027; full proposal deadline: 1 December 2027, 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: The Climate, Energy and Mobility work programme, topic HORIZON-CL5-2027-07-D3-27, Scope (pp. 179–180), funds storage demonstrations using obsolete infrastructure. Its flexibility and energy-security outcomes connect to Time-dependent transmission rights contract (Lion Storage), DataFleX and TSO Innovation Alliance. General Annex B, Entities eligible for funding and Consortium composition (pp. 11–13), permits a funded Dutch legal-entity route, subject to the topic eligibility restrictions; General Annex G, Form of grant, funding rate and maximum grant amount (pp. 31–32), permits company funding. Type 1 and C1.3 describe TenneT participating as a funded consortium partner.
